slots.title: Security failure at Indian certificate firm bites Ethereum as developers rush out fixes
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: A key blunder at Indian certificate issuer eMudhra left some Teku and Besu setups trusting forged certificates. Default mainnet nodes weren’t exposed.

slots.title: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as Samsung-led tech jitters and a hawkish Fed weigh on crypto
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Bitcoin fell below $80,000 as Samsung-driven tech weakness and a hawkish Fed hold triggered a broad risk-off move. Crypto futures saw $356 million in liquidations.

slots.title: Your fridge could one day stake Ether, launch memecoins: CFTC chair
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: CFTC chair Mike Selig says autonomous AI agents could challenge financial rules built around human traders, and regulators need to adapt.

slots.title: Upwind raises $400M after walking away from Datadog acquisition offer
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: The cloud security startup raised a Series C at a $3.8B valuation, instead of selling itself for the same price.

slots.title: AI found a way to crash bitcoin nodes on Windows and Macs. It's now public
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Three flaws a language-model scan dug up are the first disclosed under Core’s new rules for bugs that are easy to find.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Mystery Wall Street Journal ad sparks new fight over tokenized stocks
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: A full-page warning urging CEOs to opt out of tokenized stock trading drew a response from Securitize and questions over who paid for it.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
